1 package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner; 2 3 /** 4 * Immutable structured audit event emitted once per successful owner create. 5 * 6 *

Carries a monotonically increasing {@code seq}, the saved owner's {@code ownerId}, the owner's 7 * current primary identifier and its {@code membershipLevel}, with a fixed {@code event} discriminator 8 * of {@code OWNER_CREATED}. 9 * 10 *

The {@code memberId} field holds the owner's current primary identifier: the 11 * {@link org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner#getMemberId() memberId} that unifies the 12 * former customerCode and membershipNumber — the event always names whatever the current primary 13 * identifier is. 14 * 15 *

A pure data record: it is serialized to JSON by the audit step via the shared {@code ObjectMapper}, 16 * so the event renders the same way as every other DTO in the system. 17 */ 18 public record OwnerCreatedEvent(long seq, Integer ownerId, String memberId, Integer membershipLevel, 19 String event) { 20 21 /** The fixed discriminator for a successful owner create. */ 22 public static final String OWNER_CREATED = "OWNER_CREATED"; 23 24 public OwnerCreatedEvent(long seq, Integer ownerId, String memberId, Integer membershipLevel) { 25 this(seq, ownerId, memberId, membershipLevel, OWNER_CREATED); 26 } 27 } 28

2111	    Owner:
2112	      title: Owner
2113	      description: A pet owner.
2114	      allOf:
2115	        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
2116	        - type: object
2117	          properties:
2118	            id:
2119	              title: ID
2120	              description: The ID of the pet owner.
2121	              type: integer
2122	              format: int32
2123	              minimum: 0
2124	              example: 1
2125	              readOnly: true
2126	            displayName:
2127	              title: Display name
2128	              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
2129	              type: string
2130	              example: 'Franklin, George'
2131	              readOnly: true
2132	            initials:
2133	              title: Initials
2134	              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
2135	              type: string
2136	              example: 'G.F.'
2137	              readOnly: true
2138	            salutation:
2139	              title: Salutation
2140	              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the title and last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is supplied.
2141	              type: string
2142	              example: 'DR Who'
2143	              readOnly: true
2144	            telephoneDisplay:
2145	              title: Telephone display
2146	              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes separated by spaces. The known country codes are '+61' (Australia) and '+1' (NANP); any other E.164 value is split with a two-digit country code. The raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
2147	              type: string
2148	              example: '+61 412 345 678'
2149	              readOnly: true
2150	            memberId:
2151	              title: Member ID
2152	              description: The owner's member ID, the single identifier unifying the former customerCode and membershipNumber. Formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region derived from the postcode and city (NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN), FY is the 2-digit fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July) derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone followed by the lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
2153	              type: string
2154	              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
2155	              readOnly: true
2156	            fiscalYear:
2157	              title: Fiscal year
2158	              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the 2-digit fiscal-year segment of the memberId (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). A registration date in July-December yields the fiscal year starting that year; January-June yields the fiscal year that started the previous year.
2159	              type: string
2160	              example: 'FY26'
2161	              readOnly: true
2162	            householdId:
2163	              title: Household ID
2164	              description: A stable shared identifier derived from the owner's last name and postcode (the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 of normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last name and postcode share it. Owners created without a postcode have no household ID.
2165	              type: string
2166	              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
2167	              readOnly: true
2168	            identityKey:
2169	              title: Identity key
2170	              description: >-
2171	                The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of
2172	                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email segment is empty when
2173	                absent). Duplicate detection is keyed on this single value, so a create whose
2174	                identity key matches an existing active owner's is rejected with 409.
2175	              type: string
2176	              example: '3a1f9c8b2d4e6f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90112233445566778899'
2177	              readOnly: true

Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the title and last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Who'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes separated by spaces. The known country codes are '+61' (Australia) and '+1' (NANP); any other E.164 value is split with a two-digit country code. The raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's member ID, the single identifier unifying the former customerCode and membershipNumber. Formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region derived from the postcode and city (NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN), FY is the 2-digit fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July) derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone followed by the lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the 2-digit fiscal-year segment of the memberId (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). A registration date in July-December yields the fiscal year starting that year; January-June yields the fiscal year that started the previous year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier derived from the owner's last name and postcode (the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 of normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last name and postcode share it. Owners created without a postcode have no household ID.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email segment is empty when
                absent). Duplicate detection is keyed on this single value, so a create whose
                identity key matches an existing active owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '3a1f9c8b2d4e6f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90112233445566778899'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, shared the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively). Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a household of 3 or more members; adds 3 for a tenure of one or more elapsed fiscal years since the registrationDate's fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints as 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, the REGION prefix of the memberId (everything before its fixed <FY><HASH8><CHK> tail), which the create pipeline derives first from the postcode by range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither matches.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's timezone as an IANA name, derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (counted by registrationDate for the current business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners (counted case-insensitively), approaching the hard capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's last-name soundex and postcode while carrying a different identity key, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared last-name soundex and postcode, different identity key). Absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any of these hold - the owner is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate), the email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a known disposable domain's registrable base label, e.g. a subdomain of it or the same label under a different TLD), or the owner's city is at or over its soft capacity (the capacityWarning band of 40 or more owners) - otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band as of the registrationDate, derived from birthDate, 'MINOR'
                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no birthDate is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when this owner has been soft-deleted (DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags the owner deleted and retains the record), otherwise false. A newly created owner is not deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Absent when the owner has no id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility and used
            when no structured 'addressLine1' is supplied. When the structured fields are
            supplied this is also returned as the composed address: the normalized addressLine1,
            with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' input
            when present. Normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand ST/RD/AVE).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address. When present it is normalized
            and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it is stored
            and returned, and composed into the derived salutation. Optional.
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When present it
            must be 4 digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), within that region's inclusive
            range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned
            when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it drives the derived ageBand,
            computed as of the registrationDate. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode), so a second owner
            sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode is a household duplicate and is
            rejected with 409. Set this true to bypass that duplicate block and be created as a
            declared household member; a declared member is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            Owners are grouped under a householdId derived from (lastName, postcode) regardless
            of this flag.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the title and last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Who'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes separated by spaces. The known country codes are '+61' (Australia) and '+1' (NANP); any other E.164 value is split with a two-digit country code. The raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's member ID, the single identifier unifying the former customerCode and membershipNumber. Formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region derived from the postcode and city (NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN), FY is the 2-digit fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July) derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone followed by the lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the 2-digit fiscal-year segment of the memberId (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). A registration date in July-December yields the fiscal year starting that year; January-June yields the fiscal year that started the previous year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier derived from the owner's last name and postcode (the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 of normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last name and postcode share it. Owners created without a postcode have no household ID.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email segment is empty when
                absent). Duplicate detection is keyed on this single value, so a create whose
                identity key matches an existing active owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '3a1f9c8b2d4e6f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90112233445566778899'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, shared the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively). Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a household of 3 or more members; adds 3 for a tenure of one or more elapsed fiscal years since the registrationDate's fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints as 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, the REGION prefix of the memberId (everything before its fixed <FY><HASH8><CHK> tail), which the create pipeline derives first from the postcode by range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither matches.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's timezone as an IANA name, derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (counted by registrationDate for the current business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners (counted case-insensitively), approaching the hard capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's last-name soundex and postcode while carrying a different identity key, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared last-name soundex and postcode, different identity key). Absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any of these hold - the owner is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate), the email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a known disposable domain's registrable base label, e.g. a subdomain of it or the same label under a different TLD), or the owner's city is at or over its soft capacity (the capacityWarning band of 40 or more owners) - otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:

              description: >-

                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no birthDate is supplied.
              type: string

              readOnly: true
            deleted:

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:

              description: The canonical path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Absent when the owner has no id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

info:
  title: Spring PetClinic

    name: Apache 2.0

    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties

paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage

      parameters:

          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis

          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false

          description: Not modified.

          content:

        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

      parameters:

          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:

              description: An ID for this version of the response.

                type: string

              schema:

        304:
          description: Not modified.

            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.

              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility and used
            when no structured 'addressLine1' is supplied. When the structured fields are
            supplied this is also returned as the composed address: the normalized addressLine1,
            with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' input
            when present. Normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand ST/RD/AVE).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address. When present it is normalized
            and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it is stored
            and returned, and composed into the derived salutation. Optional.
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When present it
            must be 4 digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), within that region's inclusive
            range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned
            when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it drives the derived ageBand,
            computed as of the registrationDate. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode), so a second owner
            sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode is a household duplicate and is
            rejected with 409. Set this true to bypass that duplicate block and be created as a
            declared household member; a declared member is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            Owners are grouped under a householdId derived from (lastName, postcode) regardless
            of this flag.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the title and last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Who'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes separated by spaces. The known country codes are '+61' (Australia) and '+1' (NANP); any other E.164 value is split with a two-digit country code. The raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the 2-digit fiscal-year segment of the memberId (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). A registration date in July-December yields the fiscal year starting that year; January-June yields the fiscal year that started the previous year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier derived from the owner's last name and postcode (the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 of normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last name and postcode share it. Owners created without a postcode have no household ID.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email segment is empty when
                absent). Duplicate detection is keyed on this single value, so a create whose
                identity key matches an existing active owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '3a1f9c8b2d4e6f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90112233445566778899'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, shared the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively). Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a household of 3 or more members; adds 3 for a tenure of one or more elapsed fiscal years since the registrationDate's fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints as 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, the REGION prefix of the memberId (everything before its fixed <FY><HASH8><CHK> tail), which the create pipeline derives first from the postcode by range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither matches.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's timezone as an IANA name, derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (counted by registrationDate for the current business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners (counted case-insensitively), approaching the hard capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's last-name soundex and postcode while carrying a different identity key, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared last-name soundex and postcode, different identity key). Absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any of these hold - the owner is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate), the email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a known disposable domain's registrable base label, e.g. a subdomain of it or the same label under a different TLD), or the owner's city is at or over its soft capacity (the capacityWarning band of 40 or more owners) - otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band as of the registrationDate, derived from birthDate, 'MINOR'
                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no birthDate is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when this owner has been soft-deleted (DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags the owner deleted and retains the record), otherwise false. A newly created owner is not deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Absent when the owner has no id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility and used
            when no structured 'addressLine1' is supplied. When the structured fields are
            supplied this is also returned as the composed address: the normalized addressLine1,
            with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' input
            when present. Normalized (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand ST/RD/AVE).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address. When present it is normalized
            and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it is stored
            and returned, and composed into the derived salutation. Optional.
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When present it
            must be 4 digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), within that region's inclusive
            range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned
            when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it drives the derived ageBand,
            computed as of the registrationDate. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode), so a second owner
            sharing an existing owner's last name and postcode is a household duplicate and is
            rejected with 409. Set this true to bypass that duplicate block and be created as a
            declared household member; a declared member is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            Owners are grouped under a householdId derived from (lastName, postcode) regardless
            of this flag.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner representation. Always 2 for the version-2 owner identity.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's grouped version-2 identifiers (memberId, identityKey and householdId).
                Each identifier is derived with a version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2'
                version tag, so every value differs from the value it carried under version 1.
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Identity'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the title and last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Who'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes separated by spaces. The known country codes are '+61' (Australia) and '+1' (NANP); any other E.164 value is split with a two-digit country code. The raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the 2-digit fiscal-year segment of the memberId (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). A registration date in July-December yields the fiscal year starting that year; January-June yields the fiscal year that started the previous year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, shared the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively). Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a household of 3 or more members; adds 3 for a tenure of one or more elapsed fiscal years since the registrationDate's fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints as 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, the REGION prefix of the memberId (everything before its fixed <FY><HASH8><CHK> tail), which the create pipeline derives first from the postcode by range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither matches.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's timezone as an IANA name, derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (counted by registrationDate for the current business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners (counted case-insensitively), approaching the hard capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's last-name soundex and postcode while carrying a different identity key, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared last-name soundex and postcode, different identity key). Absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when any of these hold - the owner is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate), the email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a known disposable domain's registrable base label, e.g. a subdomain of it or the same label under a different TLD), or the owner's city is at or over its soft capacity (the capacityWarning band of 40 or more owners) - otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:

              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:

              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true

lines: +        An owner's grouped version-2 identifiers. The region code embedded in these identifiers,
+        and the identifiers themselves, are derived with a version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed
+        'V2' version tag, so every value differs from the value it carried under version 1. The tag
+        appears only inside these identifiers, never in the user-facing locality, timezone or owner

+          description: The owner's member ID, the single identifier unifying the former customerCode and membershipNumber. Formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the version-2 identity region (the plain region derived from the postcode and city - NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN - prefixed with the 'V2' version tag, e.g. V2NSW), FY is the 2-digit fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July) derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone followed by the lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
+            The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case SHA-256 hex digest of
+            absent; the trailing 'V2' is the fixed version tag). Duplicate detection is keyed on this
+            single value, so a create whose identity key matches an existing active owner's is

+          description: A stable shared identifier derived from the owner's last name and postcode (the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 of normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode + '|' + 'V2', mixing in the fixed version tag), so owners with the same last name and postcode share it. Owners created without a postcode have no household ID.
